note: Both sets extract the Wiring Schedule table data with high accuracy regarding values and units. However, Set A is significantly better because it maintains consistent entity naming for each symbol (e.g., 'Wiring Schedule Item 33' is always 'Wiring Schedule Item 33'). Set B inconsistently uses both 'Wiring [Number]' and 'Wiring Schedule Item [Number]' for the same symbols (e.g., Symbol 33 is labeled 'Wiring Schedule Item 33' in one claim and 'Wiring 33' in others), creating duplicate and vague entity definitions.
remarks: Both sets infer 'AWG' and 'in' units which are not explicitly in the text layer (e.g., '3#12' becomes '3#12 AWG', '3/4"C' becomes '3/4 in'). This is a common engineering normalization but technically an inference. Both sets miss the 'NOTES' section content and diagram labels (Utility Panel, Instrumentation Panel specs), focusing only on the schedule table.
